findings.title: Failure runbook self-triggers the secret scan by inlining the grep pattern
findings.body: FAILURE_RUNBOOK.md §6/§8 documents the literal secret-scan command so operators can copy it; this always matches the scan. Operator-usefulness tradeoff; commit.verify uses '|| true' (non-blocking) and the criterion is 'no real secrets', which holds.

findings.title: Transport string and FastMCP host/port env names are runtime-version dependent
findings.body: Exact DCP_FACADE_TRANSPORT value and host/port env-var names depend on the installed fastmcp version. Docs flag these UNKNOWN/verify with a mandatory loopback bind-verification gate rather than asserting an unverified default.
